rdfs:label: RightsStatement
rdfs:comment: A statement about the intellectual property rights held in or over a resource.
notes: Superclass of `urn:solid:LicenseDocument` (a rights statement that grants permissions). Use RightsStatement for copyright notices, restriction declarations or public-domain dedications that are not licences. Not `urn:solid:Policy`, which is a plan or course of action by an authority. The Rights Statements consortium (rightsstatements.org) provides a standardized set.

history.note: Documented LicenseDocument as a subclass (removed it from notToBeConfusedWith); example now uses the canonical rightsstatements.org vocab URI.
